verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs index lists a first-party Mission Control Agent for investigating your environment and making supported changes, which is a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to. The only evidence is a single one-line mention, so its depth, scope and interface are unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what tasks the agent can perform and how users invoke it in the Cloud Console, which changes count as supported and how they are governed, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Mission Control Agent and the Mission Control MCP server for investigating your environment and making supported changes.
